BiblicalUsage: Once, in Daniel's vision of the bear: it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it. The word is a rib — the bones of prey still in the beast's teeth.
TheologicalSignificance: One rib in one verse carries no teaching of its own; its weight is Daniel's vision, a beast with the bones of devoured kingdoms still in its teeth.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
